Microsoft has repeated boneheaded decisions that have damaged its Xbox brand. Xbox is currently in freefall, with new leadership taking to layoffs and cutdowns to try and save the brand, while simultaneously increasing the price of cloud subscription gaming and allowing GPUs to sit in warehouses. In this video, we dig into Microsoft's history of poor decisions and its implosion.
